page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword at the foot right, signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: Scio Deum posse (spero etiam & velle) Me restituere; nec de Illius misericordia, nec de Populi Mei amore & miseratione desperabo.

Eveniat licet quod pessimum; Id saltem confido Me Tibi in multo melius Regnum praecessurum; quod Deus mihi, & Me illi praeparavit per Servatorem meum Iesum Christum, cuius misericordiae Te & Omnes Meos commendo.
Vale; dum sit rursus congrediundi copia, si non in Terris, at in Cœlis.

page.notes: The catchword is only partly legible: "Me" with a flourish is visible, and "Meam" is inferred from the next page. The word "sit" appears to be printed with a long-s form that looks like an f; I read it as "sit". A small mark ("28.") stands between the signature and the catchword; I could not confirm whether it is printed. A short dash stands before "Eveniat" and is probably an ornament or stray mark, so I left it out. The two horizontal rules in the lower half of the page are not printed text and are not transcribed. The faint marks along the left edge are show-through or the neighbouring page and are left out.
